statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative public-path audit; no account was created and no transaction was submitted.

page.notes: Public marketplace with SSR content, listing/detail templates, signup entry and first-visit locale/consent overlays.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated dark media plus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remained rgb(237,242,242), the root color-scheme was normal, and the dark screenshot retained light surfaces.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() returned no active animations on the loaded homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Forced-colors screenshot plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The forced-colors/high-contrast screenshot retained visible text, controls, dialog boundaries and actions; Lighthouse also passed color contrast.

checkOutcomes.method: CSSOM signal probe and route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection found zero view-transition declarations across the multi-route marketplace; route changes use full page swaps without continuity.
CSSOM found no animation-timeline/scroll-timeline usage, and recon found no scroll-linked visual effect that required a main-thread or declarative implementation.
The tested marketplace paths used native scrolling and conventional button/link controls; no custom pointer-driven gesture that fights platform behavior was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: CSSOM signal probe and long-page screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSSOM found no scroll-state or scroll-timeline signal; the long listing keeps static chrome and provides no progress/position feedback.
No tooltip or edge-positioned transient menu was required on the representative public paths; the visible country/consent surfaces are modal dialogs, not anchored popovers.
checkOutcomes.reason: No applicable anchored tooltip/popover surface was present.

checkOutcomes.method: Route screenshots, heading and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Catalog and item paths expose breadcrumbs, clear headings and visible focus cues, preserving orientation from listing to detail.

A first-visit screenshot shows two simultaneous interruptions before interaction: a centered country modal obscures the page while a full-width consent banner covers the lower viewport; on 360x800 the country modal consumes nearly the whole screen.
Overlay inventory found three custom DIV role=dialog surfaces and no native dialog/popover elements; the visible country modal is manually implemented rather than using the platform dialog primitive.
After accounting for first-visit overlays, the homepage and item template devote the main area to products, imagery, price and primary actions with restrained persistent chrome.
At 360x800, homepage and item layout probes both reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, horizontalOverflowPx=0, and a viewport meta tag.
CSSOM inspection found zero @container rules despite cards, header controls and commerce panels being reused across listing/detail and narrow/wide contexts.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus and target geometry probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible keyboard-focused controls had a browser focus outline, navigation controls were generally 36-44px high, and the mobile layouts remained operable.
The homepage first content clearly asks users to sell and offers “Commencer à vendre”; item pages expose price, “Acheter”, offer and message actions.

The representative browse journey reached catalog, a live item with price and protection details, and the clearly-labelled purchase/signup entry without a dead end; account creation was not completed to avoid side effects.
An invalid route rendered an explicit Page not found state with “Explore Vinted” and “Visit Help Center” recovery actions.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 7.5s, FCP 6.1s, TBT 1,180ms and performance 0.33; the first-party trace still recorded LCP 2.26s and 435ms TBT under a separate run.
Homepage mobile CLS was 0.060 and item mobile CLS 0.053, both below the 0.1 good threshold.
Trace recorded six long tasks, a 271ms longest task and 434.76ms total blocking time; Lighthouse measured 1,180ms TBT.
HAR recorded 144 requests and 3,169,147 transferred bytes, including 73 scripts (1.30MB) and 29 images (834KB), while loadEventEnd was about 4.88s in the runtime probe.
Lighthouse estimated 267KiB unused JavaScript and 95KiB unused CSS; individual chunks were 57-87% unused and a primary CSS file was 93% unused.
Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.97 and passed button-name, link-name and form-label audits; product images carried detailed alt text.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit plus forced-colors screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed its color-contrast audit and the forced-colors capture retained readable controls and copy.
The page has header/nav/main/footer landmarks, a skip link, sequential heading audit pass, and visible outlines on focused visible links, inputs and category buttons.
Representative desktop and mobile screenshots show readable text sizing, unclipped product details and clear action labels; no horizontal overflow was measured.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport metadata, mobile layout and media inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport permits scaling, both 360px probes reflowed without overflow, and no essential audio/video needing captions appeared on audited paths.
Lighthouse reported “No browser errors logged to the console” with an empty details list.
The document has valid doctype/UTF-8 and correct displayed aspect ratios, but all 30 img elements lacked width/height attributes, 25 below-fold images were not lazy, and 22 lacked srcset.
Lighthouse found four BFCache blockers and three deprecated-API warnings from the challenge script, including deprecated Shared Storage and persistent storage usage.
Homepage, catalog/item and signup surfaces have descriptive titles; homepage has a substantive meta description.
Lighthouse passed crawlable anchors and descriptive link text; the DOM has real href links, index robots meta and a valid viewport tag.
The homepage returns 200, declares canonical https://www.vinted.fr/, exposes 27 hreflang alternatives, robots and sitemap are reachable, and robots meta is index.
Homepage provides WebPage/Organization JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata; the audited item provides matching Product/Offer JSON-LD with price, currency, availability and image.
The page is HTTPS, but the header primitive found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff header; 12 of 16 first-party cookies lacked Secure, including long-lived identifiers/session-adjacent cookies.

checkOutcomes.method: Consent screenshot, tracker and HAR primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent UI states 800 partners and purposes including precise geolocation/device identification; network recon contacted 12 non-document origins and multiple metrics/log ingress services on first load.
No browser permission was granted or prompted on load, but the signup path exposed Google/Apple/Facebook/email methods and no passkey/WebAuthn option or credential registration surface.
Headers lacked clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy as well as CSP/HSTS.
Raw server HTML returned 200 with title and meta description, was not a JS shell, and contained 53% of rendered content vocabulary; core marketplace copy/links remained present to a no-JS crawler.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshots, layout and repeated interaction heap
checkOutcomes.evidence: Country and privacy dialogs remained contained/scrollable at narrow width, mobile paths had no horizontal clipping, and repeated modal interaction did not increase retained heap.

The audited public marketplace has no manifest or controlling service worker and purchasing depends on live inventory, identity and payment; installability/offline transaction support is not a reasonable requirement for this scoped public-web audit.
checkOutcomes.reason: The live inventory/payment marketplace is intrinsically online; offline/installable behavior is out of scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A representative missing route produced an actionable error state rather than a blank shell, with links back to marketplace and help.
The page correctly declares lang=fr-FR and 27 hreflang variants, but CSSOM found zero logical-property signals and 147 physical left/right declarations, weakening writing-mode resilience.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered content and locale metadata probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: French price rendering uses decimal commas, nonbreaking spaces and EUR symbols consistently, and locale metadata declares fr-FR across representative listing/item paths.
The public audited paths show relative recency labels and product commerce data, but no scheduled cross-zone event, stored appointment or exact civil time requiring DST/time-zone arithmetic.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive event or scheduling surface exists on the representative public paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent banner provides equally visible “Accepter tout” and “Cookies requis uniquement” choices plus management, item prices show both base and buyer-protection-inclusive totals, and purchase commitments are labelled.
The tested 404 error uses neutral language and clear recovery actions; Lighthouse passed labels and accessible names. No premature validation was observed on the exposed search/signup entry.
The public signup entry offers established identity providers and an email route; the exposed search fields do not collect address/payment/account data requiring specialized autocomplete tokens.
The item page clearly displays item price, buyer-protection-inclusive total, shipping starting price, safety policy and distinct Buy/Offer/Message actions before signup.
Although 27 of 30 images were modern formats, 25 below-fold images were eager, 22 lacked responsive srcset, one hero was oversized and three assets used legacy formats.
First load transferred 3.17MB over 144 requests with 73 scripts, while Lighthouse identified 267KiB unused JS and the trace recorded 435ms blocking time.
Twelve non-document origins participated in load; third-party-style asset, consent, metrics, logging and bot-defense services contributed to a 144-request, 3.17MB first visit.
No declared agent-facing intent or WebMCP surface was found. Although product JSON-LD aids extraction, this emerging capability is not assumed without site intent.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing capability or intent was observable; emerging WebMCP exposure is therefore not required.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model task was present on the representative commerce paths that would justify built-in on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task on the audited paths calls for on-device language-model or summarizer inference.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten open/close attempts of the locale modal, heap totals were lower than the independent baseline: 822,402 vs 827,084 nodes and 45.29MB vs 45.58MB self size; no retained-growth signal appeared.
The loaded page used about 74.4MB JS heap and 2,713 live DOM elements; heap snapshot self size was about 45.6MB, proportionate to a product-rich marketplace page.
The repeated-interaction heap summary did not grow in node count or total self size versus baseline; no accumulating detached-node footprint was signalled by the summaries.

principleOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing capability or intent was observable; emerging WebMCP exposure is therefore not required. No user task on the audited paths calls for on-device language-model or summarizer inference.

paths.description: Homepage and first-visit experience: primary sell action, product feed, locale and consent overlays; desktop/mobile, dark, reduced-motion and forced-colors conditions.
Dress catalog listing archetype: breadcrumb, filtering, long feed and reusable product cards.
Live product-detail/purchase-entry archetype: media, price, protection, seller, Buy/Offer/Message actions and Product JSON-LD.
Signup/authentication entry reached from primary commercial actions; provider and email choices inspected without creating an account.
Informational content archetype explaining the marketplace model.

findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remained rgb(237,242,242), the root color-scheme was normal, and the dark screenshot retained light surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Add system-driven dark tokens with color-scheme and prefers-color-scheme/light-dark(), including overlays.

findings.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection found zero view-transition declarations across the multi-route marketplace; route changes use full page swaps without continuity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document or same-document View Transitions to listing/detail navigation, respecting reduced motion.

findings.evidence: CSSOM found no scroll-state or scroll-timeline signal; the long listing keeps static chrome and provides no progress/position feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight declarative scroll-state/progress feedback where long listings benefit.

findings.evidence: A first-visit screenshot shows two simultaneous interruptions before interaction: a centered country modal obscures the page while a full-width consent banner covers the lower viewport; on 360x800 the country modal consumes nearly the whole screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not stack country and consent interruptions; infer locale first, defer optional selection, and keep a single compact, dismissible consent choice.

findings.evidence: Overlay inventory found three custom DIV role=dialog surfaces and no native dialog/popover elements; the visible country modal is manually implemented rather than using the platform dialog primitive.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace custom role=dialog shells with native dialog/popover semantics and platform dismissal/focus behavior.

findings.evidence: CSSOM inspection found zero @container rules despite cards, header controls and commerce panels being reused across listing/detail and narrow/wide contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reused cards, header controls and commerce panels instead of viewport-only adaptation.

findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 7.5s, FCP 6.1s, TBT 1,180ms and performance 0.33; the first-party trace still recorded LCP 2.26s and 435ms TBT under a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Bring mobile LCP below 2.5s and TBT/INP into the good range by reducing startup work and prioritizing the LCP resource.

findings.evidence: Trace recorded six long tasks, a 271ms longest task and 434.76ms total blocking time; Lighthouse measured 1,180ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and defer startup tasks; isolate consent/bot-defense and nonessential hydration work from the critical interaction window.

findings.evidence: HAR recorded 144 requests and 3,169,147 transferred bytes, including 73 scripts (1.30MB) and 29 images (834KB), while loadEventEnd was about 4.88s in the runtime probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the 144-request/3.17MB critical path, preload only the true LCP asset, lazy-load below-fold inventory and apply durable caching.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 267KiB unused JavaScript and 95KiB unused CSS; individual chunks were 57-87% unused and a primary CSS file was 93% unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split and conditionally load marketplace/consent code to remove the measured 267KiB JS and 95KiB CSS waste.

findings.evidence: The document has valid doctype/UTF-8 and correct displayed aspect ratios, but all 30 img elements lacked width/height attributes, 25 below-fold images were not lazy, and 22 lacked srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for images, lazy-load below-fold inventory, and provide responsive sources.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse found four BFCache blockers and three deprecated-API warnings from the challenge script, including deprecated Shared Storage and persistent storage usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API calls from the challenge integration and eliminate actionable BFCache blockers where possible.

findings.evidence: The page is HTTPS, but the header primitive found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff header; 12 of 16 first-party cookies lacked Secure, including long-lived identifiers/session-adjacent cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, HSTS and nosniff; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure and review long-lived identifier/session cookie scope.

findings.evidence: The consent UI states 800 partners and purposes including precise geolocation/device identification; network recon contacted 12 non-document origins and multiple metrics/log ingress services on first load.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise default partner purposes/origins, keep nonessential collection off until consent, and consolidate/batch telemetry.

findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn registration and sign-in alongside federated/email paths while keeping permissions contextual.

findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy with CSP/HSTS.

findings.suggestedFix: Migrate physical left/right spacing/positioning to logical inline/block properties and test RTL expansion.

findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold product media, use responsive srcset/sizes and modern formats, and size the hero to its rendered slot.

findings.suggestedFix: Defer and batch telemetry/background work and avoid shipping unused route/consent code on first paint.

findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/request budget; delay metrics, logs and optional consent integrations until needed or idle.
